title: Weighted intersection-size variance identity
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\delta\in\mathbb{R}$, and let $U\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. For each subset $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, set $w_\delta(J)=\delta^{|J|}(1-\delta)^{n-|J|}$. Then \[\sum_{J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}} w_\delta(J)\bigl(|U\cap J|-\delta|U|\bigr)^2=\delta(1-\delta)|U|.\]
hypotheses_covered: $\delta$ is real, with no further restriction
